task: submit a plugin to the plugin directory

families.label: Submit via the claude.ai in-app form in organization Directory settings

variants.label: Team/Enterprise org with directory management access submits the public GitHub link
preconditions: the plugin repo is public on GitHub; closed-source plugins are not accepted
signed in to a claude.ai Team or Enterprise organization with directory management access (Organization Owners have it by default; on Enterprise an Owner can delegate it through a custom role)
the plugin complies with the Anthropic Software Directory Terms and Policy
steps: Run `claude plugin validate` to check formatting and structure
Sign in to claude.ai with directory management access
Share the GitHub link to your plugin in the submission form
Submit the form and wait for review
Track review status on the Directory page at claude.ai/admin-settings/directory/submissions

families.label: Submit via the Console submission form at platform.claude.com

variants.label: Individual author outside a Team/Enterprise org submits from Console
preconditions: the plugin repo is public on GitHub; closed-source plugins are not accepted
a Developer, Admin, or Owner role on a Console organization
the plugin complies with the Anthropic Software Directory Terms and Policy
steps: Run `claude plugin validate` to check formatting and structure
Sign up for Console at platform.claude.com if you are not part of a claude.ai Team or Enterprise organization
Share the GitHub link to your plugin in the submission form
Submit the form and wait for review

claude.note: Only product documenting submission; two forms: the claude.ai admin-settings form (Team/Enterprise with directory management access) and the Console web-portal form (individual authors).

checked: plugins--submit ## Getting your plugin to users
summary: One page documents plugin directory submission on claude: an admin-settings form for Team/Enterprise orgs and a Console web-portal form for individuals.
open_questions: Console is a separate web portal, not a listed product; both paths are filed under `claude` because the taxonomy has no Console product id.
The directory serves Cowork and Claude Code users, but no Cowork-side submission procedure exists, so the cowork cell is marked absent rather than sharing the claude cell.
